headline: Binance Suffers Suspected Multi-Billion-Dollar Breach
summary: Bitcoin and ether fell following a suspected $6.3 billion security breach at Binance and a Polymarket exploit. Institutional investors are rushing to withdraw funds from exchanges as blockchain researchers link the attack to North Korea's Lazarus Group.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, meaning major security breaches or liquidity outflows can trigger widespread panic and volatility across the digital asset market.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Major exchange security breaches reduce investor confidence and lead to immediate liquidations and price declines across digital assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-billion-dollar exploit at a major crypto exchange directly triggers risk-off sentiment, widespread withdrawals, and forced liquidations, pushing cryptocurrency prices down.
